standouts.head: An open gap up

standouts.head: Buyers control the volume

standouts.head: MACD positive

against.head: A lower high and a lower low

against.head: Heavy selling on the dip

against.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Nov 3, 2025 high is not done: it fell in five waves, only wave A and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the May 2, 2023–Nov 3, 2025 advance (−24% to −42%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.
